title: Debugging With AI Assistance
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting debugging with ai assistance to AI critique log showing accepted, modified, and rejected suggestions, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Write a verifiable debugging prompt that states the symptom and includes the relevant code, and contrast it with a prompt the AI can only guess at
Classify each AI debugging suggestion as accept, modify, or reject using a match check, a scope check, and a browser verify check, recording the reason
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions
Use feedback, support requests, and revision notes to improve the artifact before sharing it

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
